# nanoeffects

> A small typed event bus for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. Each handler runs as a task with an `AbortSignal`, so in-flight work can be cancelled. Policies (`latest`, `debounce`, ...) and effects (`retry`, `timeout`, ...) are plain functions.

Rules that generated code often gets wrong:

- The package is ESM only. There is no default export and no `require`.
- `const unbind = bus.on("event", handler)` subscribes and returns the unsubscribe function. There is no `subscribe` or `addListener`.
- A handler gets the payload and a task context: `(payload, ctx)`. The context has `signal`, `emit`, `on`, `run`. Pass `ctx.signal` to `fetch`.
- Effects take `ctx` as the first argument: `retry(ctx, fn, options)`, `timeout(ctx, ms, fn)`, `take(ctx, "event")`.
- Policies wrap a handler: `bus.on("search", latest(async (query, ctx) => { ... }))`.
- Each part is imported from its own path: `nanoeffects` (`createBus`), `nanoeffects/policies`, `nanoeffects/effects`, `nanoeffects/actions`, `nanoeffects/redux`, `nanoeffects/observable`, `nanoeffects/react` (`reactPlugin`, adds `bus.useEmitter` and `bus.useEventState`; `usePolicy`; needs React), `nanoeffects/svelte` (`sveltePlugin`, adds `bus.eventStore`; needs Svelte), `nanoeffects/vue` (`vuePlugin`, adds `bus.watchEmitter` and `bus.useEventRef`; needs Vue), `nanoeffects/trace` (`createTracer`, loggers, `tracePlugin`), `nanoeffects/dev`.
- `bus.emit(command(payload))` runs the command's handler and returns its result. Plain events return nothing.

## Start here

- [Guide](docs/guide.md): bus, handler context, policies, effects, commands and modules, step by step
- [Start a project from a template](docs/starter.md): `npm create nanoeffects` makes a Vite project (`vanilla`, `react`, `vue-ts`, `svelte-ts` and others, in JavaScript or TypeScript) with a bus, `debounce` and `latest`
- [Why nanoeffects exists](docs/motivation.md): logic and side effects outside UI components as plain async functions, no dependencies and no global state for SDKs and Module Federation, and why not redux-saga, RxJS, Redux or Effector
- [Package entries](docs/package.md): which import holds what
- [Stability](docs/stability.md): which entries are stable or unstable, what a breaking change is, the supported Node, TypeScript and framework versions, the call forms that stay
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): every plugin of a bus, what `bus.use` returns, and the order to use them in

## Async UI and unreliable networks

- [Policies](docs/policies.md): `latest`, `leading`, `debounce`, `throttle`, `queue`, and `key`; `withPolicy` makes one a plain function without a bus
- [Cancel stale requests and fix race conditions](docs/cancel-stale-requests.md): an older response overwrites a newer one; `latest`, `debounce`, `retry`, `timeout` in one recipe
- [Debounce a request and abort the previous one](docs/debounce-and-abort.md): `debounce` outside, `latest` inside, and when to use `throttle`
- [Prevent a double submit](docs/prevent-double-submit.md): `leading`, one run per item with `key`, retry only on network errors
- [Effects and cancellation](docs/effects.md): `retry`, `timeout`, `poll`, `take`, `all`, `race`, `backoff`
- [Errors and unheard events](docs/errors.md): `onError`, `onUnhandled`

## Domain logic and stores

- [Actions, jobs and modules](docs/actions.md): `createAction`, `createAction`, `createJob`, `createModule`
- [Connect Redux, Zustand, MobX, or Pinia](docs/stores.md): the Redux middleware and callbacks of other stores
- [Use nanoeffects with React Query and SWR](docs/query-libraries.md): call a command from `queryFn` or the SWR fetcher; `signalPlugin` passes the abort of the library to the task
- [Stop work on a server when the client leaves](docs/server.md): one `AbortController` for each request or socket, `signalPlugin`, a clean shutdown, and a queue worker; Fastify examples
- [Build a sign-up form in React](docs/react.md): a form with a username check, a submit that cannot fire twice, and retry; `useEventState` shows an event as state, `usePolicy` keeps a debounced handler between renders
- [Build a chat with entities, features, modules and a small server](docs/chat-example.md): rooms, a history under `latest`, a send under `queue` and `retry`, a search with `allSettled` and `timeout`, new messages polled with `poll`
- [Build a chat widget that listens only while it is open](docs/chat-widget.md): a bot widget for a site; opening mounts a module (handlers, polling, Escape), closing unmounts it and aborts running requests
- [Use nanoeffects in a Vue app](docs/vue.md): `vuePlugin` adds `watchEmitter` (a value of a component to the bus) and `useEventRef` (an event as a ref)
- [Use nanoeffects in a Svelte app](docs/svelte.md): `sveltePlugin` adds `eventStore` (an event as a Svelte store)
- [Context fields](docs/context.md): put a store or client on every task
- [Scopes](docs/scope.md): fields for one command, action, job, module or `emit`, and a way to replace them in a test
- [Use the bus from a class](docs/oop.md): `Emitter`, `extendBus`, `@WithBus`, `@On`, `@Once`, and `dispose()` for the subscriptions of an instance

## TypeScript

- [TypeScript in many files](docs/typescript.md): keep the types of the bus in commands and modules
